title: Legal research and drafting with AI assistants
about: Extension case: written to show how the lexicon carries to a third setting. Synthetic; not yet tested on fieldwork.

M.title: Matter inbox
M.definition: Email and matter management: where assignments and deadlines arrive.

D.title: Draft
D.definition: The memo, brief or contract being written, including AI drafting suggestions.

A.title: AI assistant
A.definition: Legal AI assistant panel: questions, answers, summaries, suggested authorities.

L.title: Legal sources
L.definition: Case-law and statute database, citator, the source documents themselves.

S.title: Sign-off
S.definition: Review by a senior lawyer and sending to the client or filing with the court.

Word processor.definition: Word processor or drafting tool where the document is written.

Legal AI assistant.definition: AI that answers legal questions, summarises sources and suggests authorities.

AI contract review.definition: AI that flags clauses or issues in a set of documents.

Case-law database.definition: Database of cases, statutes and secondary sources.

Citator.definition: Tool that checks whether a case exists, is still good law and how it has been treated.

Document management.definition: Firm's store of precedents, prior memos and client documents.

Receive assignment.definition: Take on a task from a senior lawyer or client and read what is asked.

Read documents.definition: Read the client's documents or the file.

AI issue flag.definition: An AI review tool flags a clause, document or issue for attention.

Ask AI assistant.definition: Put a legal question to an AI assistant and read its answer.

Paste AI text.definition: Copy text or citations from the AI answer into the draft.

Search case law.definition: Search the database for cases, statutes or commentary.

Read source.definition: Open and read the case, statute or document itself.

Check citation.definition: Run a citation through the citator: does it exist, is it still good law.

Find precedent.definition: Look up a prior memo, brief or contract from the firm.

Draft text.definition: The lawyer's own writing or editing of the document.

Ask colleague.definition: Ask a colleague in person or by chat.

Senior review.definition: A senior lawyer reviews the work and comments.

Send or file.definition: Send the work to the client or file it. The point where a claim reaches closure.

ai_models.research_assistant: Assistant that answers legal questions and suggests authorities.
ai_models.drafting_assistant: Assistant that writes or rewrites passages.
ai_models.contract_review: Tool that flags clauses or issues across documents.
ai_models.other: Any other model; name it in detail.

independent_checks: Reading the case or statute itself, running a citation through the citator, the client's own documents, a colleague's or senior lawyer's reading. Reading the AI's summary of a case again is not a check.
